transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I guess what finally made me ask for help is... I just barely want to eat anymore. Like, I'll be on my lunch break at the store, just staring at a sandwich or something I used to actually like, and I end up throwing most of it away. I just don't have an appetite at all.
Along with this change in your appetite, how has your mood been lately?

I don't really know. I haven't noticed my mood being all that different, to be honest. I mean... I guess I just feel like I normally do. I just go to work at the store and come home. I wouldn't say I feel sad or angry or anything specific like that. It's really just the food thing I've noticed.
Are you avoiding food because you are worried about gaining weight or unhappy with how your body looks?
No, it's nothing like that. I'm not worried about gaining weight or how my body looks or anything. I'm not on a diet. It's just... I literally have no desire to eat. I just don't feel hungry at all.
Aside from food, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy doing?

Yeah, actually, I guess I have. I used to get pretty excited about doing stuff... like going to gallery nights, playing basketball, or even just grabbing food-truck tacos. I used to help out kids with art stuff too, and I really liked that. But lately, if I try to do any of those things, I just... I don't know, I just stand there feeling completely flat. It doesn't do anything for me anymore, so I usually just end up making an excuse to leave early.
About how long have you been feeling this way and noticing these changes?

It's been going on for about two months now. I guess it started right around the time I won this award for a window display at work. The district manager was giving me a lot of attention for it, and... yeah, that's when I started noticing all this.
How has your sleep been during these past two months?

My sleep has been pretty bad, honestly. Most nights I just lie there... replaying that whole award thing in my head, and all the conversations at the store. It just keeps going around and around. And then, even if I do finally manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up way too early. Once I'm awake, that's it. I just can't get my mind to shut back off to go back to sleep.
During these past two months, have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking in energy?

Yeah, definitely. Um, usually by the middle of a shift at work, my body just feels really heavy. It's like... even just straightening up the racks or walking back to the stockroom takes way more out of me than it should. I just don't have the energy I used to.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating, focusing on tasks, or making decisions lately?

Yeah, I have. At work, I keep losing my place on simple stuff. Like, if I'm counting inventory or trying to pick out colors for a new display... I just lose my train of thought. And then I end up second-guessing myself over things I used to be able to do really fast. It's just hard to focus on what I'm doing.
During these past two months, have you been feeling down on yourself, worthless, or overly guilty about things?

Yeah, I have. Um, I just keep thinking that I really don't deserve the award I got, or the chance at being a supervisor. I feel guilty all the time, like I somehow tricked everyone into picking me. People tell me I didn't trick anyone and that I earned it, but I just can't shake that feeling.
